landing.hero.title: Turn what you say into finished, filed paperwork.
landing.hero.body: Worker is an AI administrative workplace for organizations that produce large quantities of formal documents from meetings, briefings and correspondence. Record a meeting or dictate, and Worker transcribes it, drafts minutes, memos, letters, reports and policy briefs, and takes them through review and approval — with a complete audit trail.
landing.what.title: What Worker does
landing.what.lead: The routine office work that surrounds meetings and correspondence — handled in minutes, not hours.
landing.what.f1.title: Record & transcribe
landing.what.f1.body: Capture meetings, interviews, briefings or dictation. Audio is transcribed on Worker's own servers in 67 languages.
landing.what.f2.title: Draft with AI
landing.what.f2.body: Generate minutes, memos, letters, reports, policy briefs and circulars in correct official form.
landing.what.f3.title: Review & approve
landing.what.f3.body: Every document moves through draft, review, approval and finalisation — people stay in control.
landing.what.f4.title: Secure & audited
landing.what.f4.body: Role-based access and a complete audit trail. Correspondence is only ever sent by a person.
landing.start.title: Getting started takes a minute
landing.start.lead: Create an account and start your 14-day free trial.
landing.start.s1.title: Create your account
landing.start.s1.body: Enter your name, email and a password.
landing.start.s2.title: Verify your email
landing.start.s2.body: Enter the 6-digit code we email you.
landing.start.s3.title: Sign in securely
landing.start.s3.body: Each sign-in confirms with a one-time emailed code.
landing.start.s4.title: Start working
landing.start.s4.body: Create a session, record, and generate your first document.
landing.pricing.title: Simple subscription pricing
landing.pricing.lead: Start with a 14-day free trial. Choose the plan that fits the volume of administrative work your organization produces.
landing.pricing.starter.name: Starter
landing.pricing.starter.desc: For small teams getting started with AI-assisted administrative work.
landing.pricing.professional.name: Professional
landing.pricing.professional.desc: For organizations with regular, high-volume document production.
landing.pricing.premium.name: Premium
landing.pricing.premium.desc: For larger organizations with substantial administrative workloads.
landing.pricing.paymentsNote: M-Pesa and PayPal supported for paid subscriptions.
landing.final.title: Ready to try Worker?
